name: Elkhart County, Indiana (United States)
description: White field charged with a red ring broken at the fly to form a C, three royal blue bars within it forming an E, and a yellow stalk of wheat piercing the ring and the centre bar.
history: Elkhart County is a county located in Indiana., the county's population was 207,047. The flag was adopted on 5 November 1984 (prescribed by section 1-2-2-1 of the county code of ordinances adopted on 5 November 1984, according to Flags of the World).
